messages.subject: INLA Error Message
parts:
I am doing research on duck distribution and abundance in the Great Lakes region. I am trying to follow code that was already created for a different bird species. However, I have been getting an error message in my R code when running the INLA model. It tries to run at first, then crashes and says:

"This is not what you want. Use NA values in the covariate! Error in inla.core.safe(formula = formula, family = family, contrasts = contrasts,  : *** Fail to get good enough initial values. Maybe it is due to something else."

I have been going through the original code to compare it with mine. My data and QGIS files appear to be the same projection and format as the previous code, so I'm not sure what's causing the error. Does anyone have ideas on what could be causing this error message? I can share my files if needed.
